versions.subject: feat: update rules related to onenote and more
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\onenote.exe'
        - '\onenotem.exe'
        - '\onenoteim.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains|all:
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\OneNote\'
        - '\Exported\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
        # TODO: Add more suspicious extensions
        - '.bat'
        - '.cmd'
        - '.exe'
        - '.hta'
        - '.htm'
        - '.html'
        - '.lnk'
        - '.ps1'
        - '.vbe'
        - '.vbs'
condition: selection
